description: Observe-it metrics field normalization and scalar value unification pipeline

script.description: Promote service, version, and env, copy value@int/value@double into unified value, derive delta histogram max when omitted by cumulative_to_delta, and remove attributes.data_stream
script.source: if (ctx.resource != null) { if (ctx.resource['service.name'] != null) { ctx.service = ctx.resource['service.name']; } if (ctx.resource['service.version'] != null) { ctx.version = ctx.resource['service.version']; } if (ctx.resource['deployment.environment.name'] != null) { ctx.env = ctx.resource['deployment.environment.name']; } } if (ctx.service == null && ctx.serviceName != null) { ctx.service = ctx.serviceName; } if (ctx['value@double'] != null) { ctx.value = ((Number) ctx['value@double']).doubleValue(); } else if (ctx['value@int'] != null) { ctx.value = ((Number) ctx['value@int']).doubleValue(); } if (ctx.kind == 'HISTOGRAM' && ctx.max == null && ctx.count != null && ctx.sum != null) { long count = ((Number) ctx.count).longValue(); if (count > 0L) { double sum = ((Number) ctx.sum).doubleValue(); if (count == 1L) { ctx.max = sum; if (ctx.min == null) { ctx.min = sum; } } else { double estimatedMax = sum / count; if (ctx.buckets != null) { for (def bucket : ctx.buckets) { if (bucket.count != null && ((Number) bucket.count).longValue() > 0L && bucket.min != null) { double bucketMin = ((Number) bucket.min).doubleValue(); if (bucketMin > estimatedMax) { estimatedMax = bucketMin; } } } } ctx.max = estimatedMax; } } } if (ctx.attributes != null) { ctx.attributes.remove('data_stream'); }
